summary: Wrote a 7-phase, ~7-hour implementation plan for making ROADMAP.md a generated artifact. The plan follows the research report's correction of three stale dispatch premises: the dispatch's named field list exists in no version of the live file, scripts/roadmap-integration.sh is 944 lines quarantined in scripts/deprecated/ rather than a live two-mode script, and no mechanical batch-suggestion capability is reachable (task 274's unbuilt scope). Phases: re-measure baselines, rewrite roadmap-format.md as a generation contract, build the derivation layer plus --print, add retention/--regenerate/--prune, register a test suite, rewrite roadmap-update.md as the caller contract, then registration and the full gate.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan for the roadmap generation contract, the three-mode script, the caller contract and their registration.
